title: Bingo Industries Limited - proposed acquisition of Dial-a-Dump Industries Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC requested further information from the parties.
Former provisional decision date of 8 November 2018 delayed to allow the ACCC more time to consider market feedback.
ACCC received further information from the parties.
Former provisional decision date of 22 November 2018 delayed to allow the ACCC more time to consider market feedback.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC requested further information from the parties.
ACCC published draft 87B undertaking proffered by Bingo.  ACCC sought industry participants’ views on the draft undertaking.
ACCC received further information from the parties.
Closing date for submissions relating to Bingo’s draft 87B Undertaking.
Former provisional decision date of 21 February 2019 delayed to allow the ACCC more time to analyse information received.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition, subject to a section 87B undertaking accepted by the ACCC.

body_sections.Summary: Bingo proposed to acquire Dial-a-Dump. Bingo and Dial-a-Dump are both providers of commercial and industrial, and building and demolition waste collection and processing services in the Greater Sydney area.
